messages.subject: browseURL page not displayed
parts:
Hi,
try this link
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/veepsirtt/mycalls/
the pages are not displayed.
how to get the pages?.
thanks 
veepsirtt

ui.R
--------------------------------------------------------------------
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Stocks"),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    wellPanel(
      p(strong("Stocks")),
      
      checkboxInput(inputId = "stock_1", label = "RANBAXY 800"  , value = TRUE),
      checkboxInput(inputId = "stock_2", label = "RCOM    700   ", value = TRUE)
      
    )),
  
  
  mainPanel(    
    
    
    conditionalPanel(condition = "input.stock_1",
                     br(),
                     div(plotOutput(outputId = "plot_1"))),
    
    conditionalPanel(condition = "input.stock_2",
                     br(),
                     div(plotOutput(outputId = "plot_2")))
    
  )))

server.R
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  # Make a chart for a symbol
  make_chart <- function(sym) {  
    
    u=paste("http://www.marketcalls.in/livecharts/",sym,sep="")
    
    browseURL("u")
    return()
    
  }
  
    
  
  output$plot_1 <- renderPlot(  { make_chart("ranbaxy") })
  output$plot_2 <- renderPlot(  { make_chart("rcom") })   
  
  
})


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: browseURL page not displayed
parts:
Hi - browseURL won't work when you run it on the server. What it does is, when you run it in an R session on your local computer, it will open up a web browser for you. When it's run on a remote Shiny server, nothing will happen. 

It looks like you're trying to open up new browser windows that point to various URLs. If that is what you're trying to do, you'll probably have to add javascript code that will open the windows.

-Winston

Hi shiny

I need a auto trading  platform through mql4 for this code

http://www.nseindia.com/NP/nse_paathshaala.htm

_SECTION_BEGIN("Pair Trading");
SetChartOptions(0,0,chartGrid30|chartGrid70);

_N( Symbol1= ParamStr("Symbol1", "^NSEI") );


SetForeign( Symbol1 );
C1 = C;
H1 = H;
L1 = L;
O1 = O;
V1 = V;
RestorePriceArrays();

_N( Symbol2= ParamStr("Symbol2", "^NSEBANK") );


SetForeign( Symbol2 );
C2 = C;
H2 = H;
L2 = L;
O2 = O;
V2 = V;
RestorePriceArrays();

Color = ParamColor( "Color", colorDefault );
Style = ParamStyle( "Style", styleLine, maskPrice );


PlotOHLC( O2/O1, H2/H1, L2/L1, C2/C1, "(" + Symbol2+" / "+Symbol1 + ") spread", Color, style );

AddToComposite(C2/C1, "~Pair", "X" );

SetForeign( "~Pair" );
C3 = C;
H3 = H;
L3 = L;
O3 = O;
V3 = V;
RestorePriceArrays();

EntrySignal =  Cross(EMA(C3,2),C3);
ExitSignal =   Cross(C3,EMA(C3,2));

if( Name() == "^NSEI" )
{
  Buy = EntrySignal;
  Sell = ExitSignal;
  Short= Sell;
  Cover = Buy;

   SetPositionSize( 100, spsShares );
}

if( Name() == "^NSEBANK" )
{
  Short = EntrySignal;
  Cover = ExitSignal;
  Buy = Cover;
  Sell = Short;

   SetPositionSize( 50, spsShares );
}

_SECTION_END();

====================================================
